contract: Each producer wake sends at most one movement interval covering up to the existing 12-step authority budget. Native intervals retain every recorded direction change and jump edge. Local-only elapsed time still waits for a six-step minimum batch; credit-limited remainders remain allowed. Cursors advance only after successful enqueue. Casts and movement share a load-driver wake.
regressions: A delayed native wake emits one twelve-step interval with two distinct directions at their recorded offsets and no second packet.
A contiguous four-step credit remainder preserves direction and stops at the verified ceiling.
Existing chamber-session binding, reconciliation, and context fencing checks pass.
limitations: The owning native consumer moved into verse-imported upstream; this check targets that crate.
Updated client example builds and crowded performance acceptance remain pending.
Fewer requests per catch-up wake do not establish that dispatch latency is solved.
